coverageClaim: Selected curriculum gaps only, not every source scenario.
targets: green-left-turn
Ordinary green signal permits entry but does not remove duty toward opposing straight traffic.
bending-priority-indicator
Direction-change signal depends on actual turning, not whether priority road continues.
amber-safe-stop
Amber means stop unless too close to stop without danger when signal changes.
flashing-amber
Flashing amber is caution, not a guaranteed right of way.
directional-entry-ban
C1 bans entry from indicated direction, not every form of traffic in both directions.
parking-vs-stopping
Passenger alighting can differ under C35 and C39 but general danger prohibitions remain.
base-urban-speed
General urban default speed when no other speed instruction applies.
base-rural-speed
General non-urban default speed when no other speed instruction applies.
solid-fixed-obstacle
Crossing solid line for fixed obstruction only with special care and no overriding unsafe situation.
combined-line-side
Dashed line immediately on own side of solid line determines relevant crossing exception.
pass-left-turner-on-right
Right-side passing can apply to clear left-turning vehicle, only where safe and lawful.
right-passing-limits
Two lanes alone do not authorize right-side overtaking above 70 outside exceptions.
unmarked-bus-stop
Bus-stop zone distances if no marking specifies the stopping area; passenger exception depends on bus.
parking-oneway-side
Left-side parking permitted on one-way road when other restrictions permit.
public-parking-duration
Public road/parking area 24-hour weekday default excludes day before Sunday/public holiday.
after-crossing-parking
Crossing ten-metre rule is before, not automatically after; other prohibitions still apply.
motorway-vehicle-eligibility
Designed/permitted 40 km/h condition is not an unconditional minimum driving speed.
joining-without-lane-change
Priority-road join exception when entering without changing lane; markings define separation.
narrow-bridge-yield
B6 obliges own driver to yield at a narrow passage; distinguish arrow direction.
return-space-after-overtake
Avoid cutting into stopping gap immediately after overtaking.
school-transport-flashing
School transport warning lights indicate possible children, not ordinary right of way entitlement.
height-clearance
C20 height restriction applies to actual loaded vehicle height, not unloaded specification.
daylight-running-rear
Prescribed daytime running lights may leave rear lights off in daylight, unlike darkness/bad weather.
rain-rear-lighting
Manual light activation may be needed under rain when automatic system leaves rear dark.
high-beam-following
High beam prohibited close behind a vehicle due to dazzling.
fog-and-dipped-pair
Passenger car front fog and dipped headlights not used simultaneously.
walk-bike-pedestrian
Walking a bicycle changes user status to pedestrian at uncontrolled zebra crossing.
controlled-crossing-finishing
Give pedestrian safe opportunity to finish crossing after their signal changes.
deer-collision-report
Police report and location marking after roe deer collision, even animal leaves.
horn-purpose
Audible warning only when necessary to prevent danger; no prolonged celebratory horn.
mutual-lane-merge
Two lanes merging into one requires reciprocal adaptation, not automatic alternate-car priority.
starting-from-roadside
Starting from roadside must be safe and avoid unnecessary interference; indicator grants no priority.
battery-electric-vs-plugin
Distinguish combustion hybrid, plug-in hybrid and battery electric vehicle.
automatic-licence-condition
Licence condition 78 restricts transmission independently of trip length or weight.
studded-car-trailer
Studded car requires studded trailer under winter road conditions; converse is not symmetric.
nonstudded-winter-marking
3PMSF requirement for studless light car winter tyres; avoid applying trailer transition wrongly.
licence-vs-actual-load
B combination threshold uses registered total weights; removing cargo may not cure licence mismatch.
projecting-load-marking
Load more than one metre rearward must be marked; darkness adds prescribed light/reflector.
ownership-paper-signatures
Written transfer notification needs both parties; distinguish government process from informal sale.
probation-revocation
Probation licence revocation differs from ordinary expiry and requires licence process anew.
headrest-position
Top at crown with small head gap; avoid promising complete whiplash prevention.
airbag-belt-complement
Airbag complements restraint rather than replacing belt.
idle-local-limit
Local idle-time rules vary; do not assert universal Swedish one-minute statutory cap.
hybrid-external-charge
Ordinary non-plug-in hybrid cannot be assumed chargeable from mains.
environment-zone-class2
Petrol Euro5 versus diesel Euro6 requirements, without inventing active geographic zone.
environment-zone-class3
Ordinary petrol/diesel passenger car excluded by fuel requirement despite newness.
ev-safe-charging
Routine long-duration charging should use suitable charging infrastructure; avoid unsafe ordinary-socket advice.
ev-cable-extension
No extension-cord workaround for vehicle charging at ordinary socket.
visual-scan
Active observation includes intersections/road edges; no unverifiable vision-percentage statistics.
corrective-lenses-condition
Licence condition requiring glasses/contact lenses must be obeyed even short trip.
children-procession
Do not break a supervised group of children even where a gap appears sufficient.
road-obstacle-duty
Driver who loses dangerous cargo removes/marks it rather than assuming following traffic copes.
